entities.name: Propofol
observations: In goats under constant isoflurane, torso delivery depressed lumbar dorsal-horn neuronal responses to noxious hindlimb mechanical stimulation; cranial delivery had no significant effect.

entities.name: PMID:10730741
observations: Goat study using cranial bypass, lumbar laminectomy, and microelectrode recording; torso propofol reduced responses from 500±243 to 174±240 impulses/min at 1 mg/kg and from 478±204 to 91±138 impulses/min at 3.75 mg/kg, while cranial doses produced no significant change.

entities.name: Direct spinal depression
observations: Differential delivery supports a direct depressant effect of propofol on lumbar dorsal-horn neuronal responses, with little or no indirect supraspinal effect in goats.
